message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: Lin, a business employee of a company, used his position to misappropriate company funds (280,600 yuan) and held them for more than three months, then returned all after. This is typical of "挪用资金" (misappropriation of funds) or "职务侵占" (embezzlement) or "挪用特定款物"? Since he is a business employee, not a public official. For private sector, the crime is "挪用资金" (embezzlement of corporate funds) which is under the crime of "挪用资金罪" (embezzlement). In Chinese criminal law, "挪用资金罪" is for employees of enterprises, institutions, etc. The examples: earlier we saw "挪用资金" for a travel agency employee. Also "职务侵占" is for public officials. So answer: 挪用资金.

Thus final answer: [罪名]挪用资金<eoa>
